findings.finding: Correctly validates that when DC.iohgatp.MODE is Bare, DC.msiptp.MODE must be Off. Returns false on violation, causing the caller to report DDT_MISCONFIGURED (cause=259) as recommended by the RISC-V IOMMU spec PR#617. The check closes a security gap where MSI translation could occur without a valid GSCID when second-stage translation is disabled, potentially enabling cross-VM MSI injection.

spec_citations.excerpt: When DC.iohgatp.MODE is Bare, the msiptp.MODE must be set to Off.

When DC.iohgatp.MODE is Bare, DC.msiptp.MODE must be set to Off by software. All other settings are reserved. Implementations are recommended to stop and report 'DDT entry misconfigured' (cause = 259) if a reserved setting is detected.
